nodes.name: Webhook — Receive Claim
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives: image_base64, customer_description, order_id, product_name, product_category, purchase_price, delivery_status

nodes.name: Agent 1 — Vision Agent
nodes.notes: Multimodal damage analysis (Gemini). Returns: product_type, damage_type, severity, confidence, description_consistency, visual_evidence, uncertainty

nodes.name: Agent 2 — RAG Agent
nodes.notes: Modular RAG policy retrieval (ChromaDB + cross-encoder). Returns: applicable_policy, summary, sources, chunks

parameters.jsCode:
const vision = $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json;
const rag    = $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json;
const claim  = $('Webhook — Receive Claim').item.json.body;

return [{ json: {
  product_category:        vision.product_category,
  product_type:            vision.product_type,
  damage_type:             vision.damage_type,
  damage_location:         vision.damage_location,
  severity:                vision.severity,
  confidence:              vision.confidence,
  visual_evidence:         vision.visual_evidence,
  description_consistency: vision.description_consistency,
  uncertainty:             vision.uncertainty,
  rag_query:               rag.query,
  applicable_policy:       rag.applicable_policy,
  policy_summary:          rag.summary,
  policy_sources:          rag.sources,
  policy_chunks:           rag.chunks,
  retrieval_successful:    rag.retrieval_successful,
  order_id:                claim.order_id,
  product_name:            claim.product_name,
  product_category_order:  claim.product_category,
  purchase_price:          claim.purchase_price,
  delivery_status:         claim.delivery_status
}}];

nodes.name: Merge — Vision + RAG + Claim
nodes.notes: Combines Vision + RAG output + original claim data into one payload for Agent 3

nodes.name: Agent 3 — Decision Agent
nodes.notes: Claim evaluation with Python guardrails + Gemini LLM. Returns: decision, confidence, risk_level, reason, guardrail_hit, evidence_chain

nodes.name: IF — APPROVED or HUMAN_REVIEW
nodes.notes: True branch = APPROVED. False branch = HUMAN_REVIEW.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', decision: { decision: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.decision, confidence: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.confidence, risk_level: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.risk_level, reason: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.reason, guardrail_hit: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.guardrail_hit, evidence_chain: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.evidence_chain, reasoning_steps: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.reasoning_steps }, vision: { product_category: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.product_category, product_type: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.product_type, damage_type: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.damage_type, damage_location: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.damage_location, severity: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.severity, confidence: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.confidence, visual_evidence: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.visual_evidence, description_consistency: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.description_consistency, uncertainty: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.uncertainty }, rag: { query: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.query, applicable_policy: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.applicable_policy, summary: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.summary, sources: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.sources, chunks: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.chunks, retrieval_successful: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.retrieval_successful } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'escalated', decision: { decision: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.decision, confidence: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.confidence, risk_level: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.risk_level, reason: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.reason, guardrail_hit: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.guardrail_hit, evidence_chain: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.evidence_chain, reasoning_steps: $('Agent 3 — Decision Agent').item.json.reasoning_steps }, vision: { product_category: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.product_category, product_type: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.product_type, damage_type: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.damage_type, damage_location: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.damage_location, severity: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.severity, confidence: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.confidence, visual_evidence: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.visual_evidence, description_consistency: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.description_consistency, uncertainty: $('Agent 1 — Vision Agent').item.json.uncertainty }, rag: { query: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.query, applicable_policy: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.applicable_policy, summary: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.summary, sources: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.sources, chunks: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.chunks, retrieval_successful: $('Agent 2 — RAG Agent').item.json.retrieval_successful } }) }}
